2 reduce/reduce conflicts resolved

state:
  x -> "c" •
  y -> "c" •
  distinguished by lookaheads:
    x -> "c" •  {"d", "f"}
    y -> "c" •  {"e", "f"}

  reduce/reduce conflict on terminal "f":
    reduce: x -> "c" (chosen)
    reduce: y -> "c"
    ambiguous for start:
      example: "a" "c" • "f"
      using the first reduction:
        start -> "a" [x] "f"
          x -> "c" •
      using the second reduction:
        start -> "a" [y] "f"
          y -> "c" •
